investment.mark_help: Tag this transaction for your own reference (does not create a portfolio line by itself).
investment.create_hint: Creates a portfolio line from this transaction’s amount. If the charge is in ₪ but you leave “Tel Aviv” variants off, the row is stored in US$ using USD/ILS on the transaction date (Frankfurter/Yahoo) for quantity and cost per share.
investment.already_linked: A portfolio line is already linked to this transaction.
investment.yahoo_ta_help: Yahoo Tel Aviv symbol variants (TA.* / *.TA) for price history.
investment.auto_qty_hint: Leave quantity empty to estimate shares from cost and historical price on that date. ILS→US$ uses the FX rate on that date when the row is in USD.
investment.feature_disabled_hint: Investments are turned off in Configuration → Investments. Enable them there to edit portfolio actions.
